# The fixture destination's own limit on an external link in a post

## Statement
The destination's published policy limits where an external link may appear in
a post. A post that places one elsewhere is refused by the platform, not merely
shown to fewer readers.

## Applies when
always

## Influences
- S-10 · `E-14.cross_destination_link` — where the cross-destination link goes.

## Conflicts
None known.

## Source
A fixture record for the Knowledge Maintenance job: a hard platform rule past
its `review_by`, which §5 keeps enforced and flags instead of demoting.
